title: I built a mod that turns DOTA 2 into a 3rd Person ARPG that works with any controller
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
I wanted to take a break from building my MMORPG to hop back into game modding. Between game development and game modding, I will never be bored again.

  
I have NEVER played DOTA in my life. My wife barred me from playing LoL. The reason I hate MOBAs has always been because you have to POINT AND CLICK just to move. Ew...

  
So, I finally did what I have wanted to do my entire life, mod a MOBA so that it runs in third person and I can use my controller 100% to play the game, control the menus, attack, etc

  
You press the \`select\` key to swap between controller and mouse controls. It allows you to move the mouse with the left and right analog stick when in mouse control mode.

  
I have a few other mods that I haven't shared with anyone and tons more planned. What are your thoughts? Have you been having fun modding games that catch your eye? I know I have!
